name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR first. It catches routing errors before they hit users, saving time and trust. The trade-off is delayed feedback for the PR author, but catching issues early outweighs that cost.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on open PRs risks slowing down reviews by adding noise to every PR, not just the newest—authors may ignore critical feedback if it’s buried in false positives. Instead, run PR-Agent in shadow mode on a random 10% of merged PRs weekly to catch systemic issues without disrupting workflows; if error rates spike, expand coverage. Settle it by measuring review time impact and false positive rate over two weeks.
